Class GrokSettingsDocument

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.GrokSettingsDocument
public final class GrokSettingsDocument extends Object
The GrokSettingsDocument class reads and writes aetheris-grok.yaml. The file lives in .casserole under the home directory. The file is not the air-gap file. The file is not the client account file. A version other than 1 is left unread and is not overwritten. A key found in the file is not written back. // @aa-sdd G-12 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Method Details

    • effortRows

      static String[] effortRows(String model)
      The method lists the effort rows for one model id. grok-4.7, grok-4.6, and grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309 list low, medium, high, and xhigh. grok-4.5 lists low, medium, and high. An empty id lists high only. Every other id lists high only. The list never contains omit.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      Returns:
      The return value is the row labels.

    • effortStart

      static String effortStart(String model)
      The method returns the factory effort. The model id is not read. The factory effort is always high.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id, and it is ignored.
      Returns:
      The return value is high.

    • sendsEffort

      static boolean sendsEffort(String model)
      The method reports whether a fresh cell sends reasoning_effort. grok-4.20-0309-reasoning returns false. grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning returns false. grok-build-0.1 returns false. Every other id returns true. A stored send_reasoning_effort wins over this start when the file contains that key.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      Returns:
      The return value is false for the ids that refuse the effort field.

    • normalizeEffort

      static String normalizeEffort(String model, String value)
      The method keeps a stored effort only when it is still a row for the model. An empty value is not a row. omit is not a row. A value that is not in effortRows(String) is replaced by effortStart(String).
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      value - The value is the stored level, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the stored level when it is still a row, and otherwise high.

    • consoleSeed

      public static String[] consoleSeed()
      The method returns the standing Grok row for a console whose Grok id is still empty. Index 0 is the model id. Index 1 is the effort. Index 2 is true or false for sending the effort. Index 3 is the stream flag. Index 4 is the burner-cloud flag. A missing file, a blocked file, or an empty model uses the factory row. That factory model is grok-4.3. The factory effort is high. The factory send flag is on. The factory stream flag is off. The factory burner-cloud flag is off. No API key is returned. The file is not written.
      Returns:
      The return value is those five strings, and index 0 is never empty.

    • write

      void write(String cellId, GrokSettingsDocument.Entry entry, boolean alsoDefault)
      The write method stores one cell and writes the file. A blocked document returns without writing. A null cell id returns without writing. An empty cell id returns without writing. A null entry returns without writing. A null model is stored as empty. An empty model never becomes the standing default. A non-empty model becomes the standing default when alsoDefault is true. A non-empty model also becomes the standing default when no standing default exists.
      Parameters:
      cellId - The cell id is the vault cell id.
      entry - The entry holds the dialog values.
      alsoDefault - The flag is true when this entry also becomes the standing default.

    • copyOnto

      void copyOnto(String cellId, GrokSettingsDocument.Entry source)
      The copyOnto method copies one entry onto a cell. A null source returns without writing. The copy calls write(String, GrokSettingsDocument.Entry, boolean) with the standing flag false. An empty model does not become the standing default. A non-empty model becomes the standing default when none exists.
      Parameters:
      cellId - The cell id is the vault cell id.
      source - The source is the nearest cell or the standing default.

    • forgetAll

      void forgetAll(List<String> ids)
      The forgetAll method drops cell entries that left the canvas. A blocked document returns without writing. A null list returns without writing. An empty list returns without writing. The file is written only when at least one stored id was removed.
      Parameters:
      ids - The ids are the cell ids that left the canvas.

    • load

      private void load()
      The load method reads the file into this document. A null file returns without reading. A path that is not a file returns without reading. A root that is not a map sets the blocked flag. A version other than 1 sets the blocked flag. A default map becomes standing only when its model is non-empty. A cells map stores each map value under its key. A null key is skipped. A value that is not a map is skipped. An exception sets the blocked flag. That same exception clears the standing default. That same exception clears the cells. The reader is closed afterward.

    • save

      private void save()
      The save method writes version 1 in block style. A blocked document returns without writing. A missing parent directory is created. The standing default is written only when it exists. Every stored cell is written. A write failure is ignored. The writer is closed afterward.

    • versionOne

      private static boolean versionOne(Object value)
      The versionOne method reports whether a version value is 1. A number matches when its int value is 1. Any other non-null value matches when its trimmed text is 1. A null value returns false.
      Parameters:
      value - The value is the version field from the file.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the version is 1.

    • parseEntry

      private static GrokSettingsDocument.Entry parseEntry(Map<?,?> raw)
      The parseEntry method builds an entry from one map. The start is factory(). An empty API becomes chat. The model is the trimmed model text. The effort is passed through normalizeEffort(String, String). A present send_reasoning_effort uses bool(Object). A missing send_reasoning_effort uses sendsEffort(String) for the model. Stream and burner-cloud use bool(Object). A numeric temperature replaces 1.0. A numeric max_completion_tokens replaces 128000.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw map is one default or cell object.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parsed entry.

    • mapOf

      private static Map<String,Object> mapOf(GrokSettingsDocument.Entry entry)
      The mapOf method writes one entry as a map. An empty API is written as chat. A null model is written as empty. The effort is passed through normalizeEffort(String, String). The map writes api. The map writes model. The map writes reasoning_effort. The map writes send_reasoning_effort. The map writes stream. The map writes burner_cloud. The map writes temperature. The map writes max_completion_tokens.
      Parameters:
      entry - The entry is the settings object.
      Returns:
      The return value is that map.

    • bool

      private static boolean bool(Object value)
      The bool method reads a yes-or-no field. A Boolean returns its own value. A null value returns false. The text true returns true. The text yes returns true. The text 1 returns true. true and yes ignore case. 1 must match exactly. Every other text returns false.
      Parameters:
      value - The value is a file field.
      Returns:
      The return value is that flag.
